findings.detail: The triggered 24907 CastSpell path remains responsible for normal area propagation; Moonkin Form then uses native AddAura, BuildEffectMaskForOwner, AddStaticApplication, and ApplyForTargets to bind the owner application, including an already-owned aura refresh.
The prior UnitAura owner-only area-aura guard remains intact and FillTargetMap remains the non-owner propagation path.
The rework does not write UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED, percentages, coefficients, or ledger values; it relies on the native 24907 aura effect handler.
Form removal still uses the existing RemoveOwnedAura path for 24907.
The exact 300-second native canary must still show the pinned direct-cast speed envelope before the edge can be accepted.

jev.adjudication: The source review approves the bounded native lifecycle repair while retaining the runtime canary gate.
jev.reason: No separate JEV checkpoint was requested for this independent code review.

laya.adjudication: The exact build and canary remain the acceptance authority.
laya.reason: No local Laya provider checkpoint was requested.
